markets.name: ICA
markets.note: anchor; recon 2026-07-02: requests GET www.ica.se/ = 200 (content/recipes shell, no product data server-side). Playwright (headless chromium) loading the site mints a per-session Bearer token used against the public gateway apimgw-pub.ica.se; GET https://apimgw-pub.ica.se/sverige/digx/offerreader/v1/offers/store/{storeId} with that Bearer returns a real per-store JSON offer listing (name/brand/packageInformation/eans (GTIN)/regularPriceFrom-To/discountValue/requirementValue). Fixture captured from store 12805 (ICA Nara Sergels Torg, Stockholm).
